children: Overview
Nigeria gold miner's Q3 revenue totaled $81.7 mln, with gold sales of 19,000 oz
Company lowered FY 2026 production guidance due to severe rainfall impacting Segilola operations
Company will pay C$0.0125 per share quarterly dividend in November
Outlook
Company lowers FY 2026 gold production guidance to 70,000-72,000 oz from 75,000-85,000 oz
Company maintains FY 2026 AISC guidance at $1,000-$1,200 per oz
Company to continue exploration drilling and sampling across Nigeria, Senegal, and Côte d'Ivoire
Result Drivers
SEVERE RAINFALL - Co said exceptionally heavy rainfall at Segilola mine disrupted operations during the quarter
EXPLORATION RESULTS - Co reported encouraging high grade drilling results from Segilola and progress across exploration portfolio
